title: Kanban swimlane: the lane for cards with no value is headed by the English constant "Uncategorized" under every locale (the pack's kanban.uncategorized is not read by KanbanImpl)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible localization defect, from the os-dev report on objectui#12838 (PR #12898, out-of-scope finding). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What

In swimlane mode, `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` buckets cards with no value in the swimlane field under the English constant `UNCATEGORIZED_LANE = 'Uncategorized'` (line 69 on `main`), and paints it as the lane heading (`{lane}`, about line 1459). Under zh the heading reads "UNCATEGORIZED" (uppercase CSS) in English.

- The packs already carry `kanban.uncategorized` (zh `未分类`), and `KanbanBoardCore.tsx` reads it for the column path. `KanbanImpl.tsx` does not.
- After PR #12898, the same constant is also interpolated into the swimlane cell's accessible name (`kanban.laneCards`), so the zh name reads "待规划 - Uncategorized 的卡片".
- The constant is also the bucket KEY (lines 982, 1448, 1473), so a fix should translate the DISPLAY only, not the key; a record whose value is literally "Uncategorized" already shares that bucket today.

**reach:** any kanban with `swimlaneField` set where some card has no value in that field, under a non-English locale. Source reading only; not measured in a browser.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The first landing is `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`.
